fullPassage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.

❌ ② (A)의 rich family는 '흔한'이 아니라 '부유한'이에요.
✅ ③ (A) a rich family는 '부유한' 가정, (B) rich and full of flavor는 '풍미가 깊은(진한)' 맛이라 문맥별 의미가 정확해요. ← 정답
❌ ④ (B)의 rich는 맛을 가리키므로 '부유한'이 아니에요.
det.tip: rich family(부유한) vs rich flavor(풍미가 깊은) — 같은 rich가 뜻이 달라요.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a large group or wide range of different things"

det.korean: array(집합/다양한 모음) — 다양한 것들의 커다란 무리나 폭넓은 범위.
det.analysis:
✅ ① array: '다양한 것들의 커다란 무리나 폭넓은 범위'라는 정의와 일치해요(the array of ... food products). ← 정답
❌ ② hazard(위험): 위험 요소라는 뜻이라 정의와 달라요.
❌ ③ diet(식단): 먹는 음식이라 정의와 맞지 않아요.
❌ ④ worth(가치): 가치라는 뜻이라 정의와 달라요.
det.tip: array = 다양한 것들의 폭넓은 집합.

questions.passage: The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made __________ (taste) by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

... the array of such processed food products, made __________ (taste) by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt ...

det.korean: taste를 형용사로 변형.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'made ___ by ~'는 '~에 의해 …하게 만들어진'이라는 뜻이에요. 뒤에서 상태를 나타내는 형용사가 필요하므로 taste를 형용사 tasty(맛있는)로 바꿔 'made tasty(맛있게 만들어진)'를 완성해요.
det.tip: make + 목적어 + 형용사: made tasty(맛있게 만들다)의 형용사형.

questions.passage: And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences, people are no longer __________ (assure) that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

... people are no longer __________ (assure) that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.

det.korean: assure를 수동태 형태로 변형.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'people are no longer ___'에서 사람들은 보장을 '받는' 대상이에요. be동사 뒤에서 수동태(be+과거분사)를 만들어야 하므로 assure를 과거분사 assured로 바꿔 'are no longer assured(더 이상 보장받지 못한다)'를 완성해요.
det.tip: 수동태 be + 과거분사: are assured(보장받다). assure → assured.

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their __________. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get a nutritionally adequate diet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: nutritional worth(영양적 가치) — 기술이 맛을 영양적 가치에서 분리했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① physical shape(물리적 모양): 맛과 분리된 대상이 아니에요.
✅ ② nutritional worth: 'separated the tastiness of foods from their ___'에서 맛을 '영양적 가치(nutritional worth)'에서 떼어 놓았다는 뜻이에요. ← 정답
❌ ③ bright color(밝은 색): 본문 흐름과 맞지 않아요.
❌ ④ sweet flavor(단맛): 맛(tastiness)과 같은 편이라 '분리' 대상이 아니에요.
det.tip: tastiness(맛)를 nutritional worth(영양 가치)에서 분리했다는 대비 구조.

questions.passage: Technology has made it possible to manipulate foods' sensory properties to make them sweeter or saltier or richer tasting or more colorful at will. Thus, technology has fully separated the tastiness of foods from their nutritional worth. In addition, current technology creates notorious hazards for energy perception. The fat content of many processed foods is not clearly evident from either the appearance of the food, its feel and taste, or from the packaging and shape of the item. The energy content of a variety of similar-tasting foods can vary considerably. And the array of such processed food products, made tasty by the addition of fat, sugar, and salt, is vast. This means that by following their food preferences — eating a variety of tasty foods — people are no longer assured that they will get __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a nutritionally adequate diet(영양적으로 적절한 식단) — 맛만 좇으면 보장받지 못하는 것.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a wider variety of flavors(더 다양한 맛): 맛을 좇으면 오히려 얻는 것이라 빈칸과 안 맞아요.
❌ ② a cheaper shopping list(더 저렴한 장보기 목록): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.
❌ ③ a longer shelf life(더 긴 유통기한): 본문과 무관해요.
✅ ④ a nutritionally adequate diet: 맛만 좇으면 '영양적으로 적절한 식단'을 더 이상 보장받지 못한다는 글의 결론이에요. ← 정답
det.tip: 맛(tasty)을 좇으면 nutritionally adequate diet(영양적으로 적절한 식단)를 놓친다.
